messages:
Alex (CEO): Hey team :wave: Quick walkthrough of Q1 pipeline + partnerships — highlights and a few open Qs. TL;DR: pipeline trending up, top 10 deals progressing to legal, we signed a pilot with a strategic partner, and we need alignment on the co-sell motion.
Tara - VP Sales: Can you share the update on ARR coverage and conversion from demo->PO? numbers please.
Alex (CEO): Current ARR coverage ~3.2x vs target; demo->PO conversion improved to 8% (was 5% last quarter). Biggest lift from two AE-led plays.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Is the growth team still prioritizing self-serve funnel optimization or shifting effort to enable inside sales for mid-market?
Tara - VP Sales: Short answer: both. We keep self-serve velocity work, but we're allocating +2 SDRs to support mid-market AEs this quarter to speed pipeline creation.
Ana (PM, Product): For the partner pilot — any roadmap dependencies? Do we need new work for SSO/integration or is current private deployment flow sufficient?
Liam (Partnerships): Pilot requires SSO (SAML) and a small webhooks surface for sync. Private deployment flow covers infra; engineering needs a 2-week spike to validate SAML and webhook scale.
Rachel (Ops): Ops note — if partners request Dedicated for pilot data isolation, we'll need a temporary SLA and a controlled onboarding runbook. I can draft the runbook this week.
Maya (Finance): For co-sell, what discount bands are we willing to authorize at AE level vs exec approval? need guardrails before we enable partners.
Tara - VP Sales: AE-level discounts up to 15% pre-approved. Anything >15% or enterprise-level structure needs RevOps + Sales exec sign-off. We'll document in the playbook.
Alex (CEO): Good. Action items: 1) Liam + Eng to scope 2-week SAML/webhook spike. 2) Rachel to draft partner onboarding runbook. 3) RevOps + Tara to finalize discount bands. We'll schedule a 30-min follow-up next Tuesday.
Liam (Partnerships): Also — pilot partner asked for a co-branded case study clause. Legal ok with a short approval SLA?
Tara - VP Sales: We can commit to a 5-business-day review for co-branded materials.
Ana (PM, Product): To be explicit about the engineering impact: estimate 2 devs for 10 days + 1 QA for 5 days. If that's acceptable I'll add to sprint.
Alex (CEO): That's acceptable. Please tag the ticket with "partner-pilot-q1" and put an owners field.
Jamal (Head of Growth): On GTM, can we get a short one-pager that explains partner co-sell vs referral flow for PMs and growth? helps avoid misalignment.
Liam (Partnerships): I'll produce a 1-pager and share in #partnerships by Friday.
Rachel (Ops): For Dedicated onboarding — checklist preview: infra creds, networking diagram, monitoring hooks, rollback play. I'll post the checklist in the doc repo.
all-hands-bot: Note: Follow-up session added to calendar "Partnership Pilot Sync" on Tue 10:00 AM PT (invites sent).
Maya (Finance): One more on pricing — for the pilot should we use production pricing or partner pilot pricing (discounted)? recommendation: limited-time pilot pricing (15% off) to avoid locking long-term comps.
Tara - VP Sales: Agreed, pilot pricing = 15% off standard list, with a pilot success clause to renegotiate on renewal.
Alex (CEO): Great. Last ask: if anyone has blockers to the 2-week spike or resource conflicts, ping me and Tara directly. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Ana (PM, Product): Will add the spike ticket and link the sprint card.
Liam (Partnerships): Sharing pilot partner name in DM per NDA.
Tara - VP Sales: Thanks folks — appreciate the quick sync.
Alex (CEO): Closing thread — please add any follow-ups to the calendar invite or the shared doc.
